target.description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_samer_w0.md, section 7.1: smoke size by condensation and Brownian coagulation, and the ISS detector scatter channel. Material indicators and no_flow are derived from material and inlet_velocity by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py; the other features are case inputs under their own names. (no target is a shared quantity); targets: d10, d30, iss_full_scale
excludes: phase_end_time is named here only because ModelSpec.target requires one shared quantity: every target of this model is lane-local and no artifact carries phase_end_time
samer:d10 (positive, m): lane-local target, not a shared quantity
samer:d30 (positive, m): lane-local target, not a shared quantity
samer:iss_full_scale (binary): lane-local target, not a shared quantity

features.name: is_kapton
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_kapton.centre) / x.is_kapton.scale; refused unless x.is_kapton.lo <= x <= x.is_kapton.hi @1

features.name: is_teflon
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_teflon.centre) / x.is_teflon.scale; refused unless x.is_teflon.lo <= x <= x.is_teflon.hi @1

features.name: is_silicone
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_silicone.centre) / x.is_silicone.scale; refused unless x.is_silicone.lo <= x <= x.is_silicone.hi @1

features.name: is_pyrell
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_pyrell.centre) / x.is_pyrell.scale; refused unless x.is_pyrell.lo <= x <= x.is_pyrell.hi @1

features.name: sample_temperature
features.transform: identity: (x - x.sample_temperature.centre) / x.sample_temperature.scale; refused unless x.sample_temperature.lo <= x <= x.sample_temperature.hi @1

features.name: inlet_velocity
features.transform: identity: (x - x.inlet_velocity.centre) / x.inlet_velocity.scale; refused unless x.inlet_velocity.lo <= x <= x.inlet_velocity.hi @1

features.name: no_flow
features.transform: identity: (x - x.no_flow.centre) / x.no_flow.scale; refused unless x.no_flow.lo <= x <= x.no_flow.hi @1

features.name: net_aging_time
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.net_aging_time.centre) / x.net_aging_time.scale; refused unless x.net_aging_time.lo <= x <= x.net_aging_time.hi @1

features.name: heating_duration
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.heating_duration.centre) / x.heating_duration.scale; refused unless x.heating_duration.lo <= x <= x.heating_duration.hi @1

notes: Generic law forward law.rs, declaration configs/models/law/samer/decl.json (status Declared): {"slug":"samer","status":"declared","family":"other","investigation":"PSI-101, SAME-R: smoke of overheated spacecraft materials, aged and measured in the Microgravity Science Glovebox","description":"W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_samer_w0.md, section 7.1: smoke size by condensation and Brownian coagulation, and the ISS detector scatter channel. Material indicators and no_flow are derived from material and inlet_velocity by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py; the other features are case inputs under their own names.","features":[{"name":"is_kapton","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"material indicator"},{"name":"is_teflon","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"material indicator"},{"name":"is_silicone","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"material indicator"},{"name":"is_pyrell","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"material indicator (lamp wick is the reference)"},{"name":"sample_temperature","unit":"K","transform":"identity","description":"sample temperature during heating"},{"name":"inlet_velocity","unit":"m/s","transform":"identity","description":"nominal duct air speed during heating"},{"name":"no_flow","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"1 when the inlet velocity is 0"},{"name":"net_aging_time","unit":"s","transform":"ln","description":"the horizon: age of the smoke when the row was measured"},{"name":"heating_duration","unit":"s","transform":"ln","description":"heating time of the sample"}],"targets":[{"name":"d10","kind":"positive","unit":"m","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"count mean diameter M1/M0 at net_aging_time (lane-local)"},{"name":"d30","kind":"positive","unit":"m","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"diameter of average mass at net_aging_time (lane-local)"},{"name":"iss_full_scale","kind":"binary","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"ISS detector scatter channel at full scale, |V| >= 6.0 V"}]}. Each network is N(z) = b0 + skip . z + sum_j w2[j] relu(b1[j] + W1[j, :] . z). A positive target is a mixture of two log-normals of one median exp(N_median), ln-sds N_spread and tail_width * N_spread, weights 1 - tail_weight and tail_weight; a non-positive spread is refused. A binary target is logistic(N_logit). An event target is the competition of log-logistic clocks exp(N_c), shape c.shape, conditioned on no event before the cutoff; the earliest control stage scheduled_stop or flow_stop, and the declared stop condition plus each offset node with a positive weight, take the active mass. Lane-local targets are labelled <slug>:<target> in diagnostics.law and carry no shared quantity. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
